name: ash
description: ash — the personal-agent layer on top of DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

scripts.test: npm run -s gen:ui && node --expose-internals --import tsx --test --test-force-exit packages/*/test/*.test.ts
scripts.build:core: npm run -s gen:ui && esbuild packages/core/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=packages/core/dist/ash-core.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'node:module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:payload: npm run -s build:core && node payload/assemble.mjs --out build/payload
